messages:
maya.l: Auditor asked for a compact evidence bundle: RBAC change mapping to control IDs, deploy session logs proving privileged deploys, and KMS envelope metadata for secrets used in the rollout. Need this by Wednesday.

devon.k: Clarify scope: last external audit onwards or rolling 30 days?

maya.l: Auditor said since last external audit -> include from 2025-01-01. Focus on production clusters and CI service accounts only.

samira: I'll extract rolebinding diffs and PR links. For logs do they want parsed timeline CSV + raw samples?

auditor_amy: Parsed timeline preferred + a few raw samples for provenance. Need chainable proof: approver, triggering CI job, and session IDs. Strip emails per PII policy.

ops_jordan: We can export deploy session audit from bastion + CI run metadata. Example sample we can include:

2025-02-18T09:12:34Z deploy-job=ci-deploy-frontend run=6789 user=devon.k session_id=sess-abc123 action=promote_to_prod
2025-02-18T09:12:40Z session=sess-abc123 exec=kubectl apply -f release/2025-02-18

maya.l: For KMS they want envelope metadata: CMK ID, key version/rotation timestamp, and a note that plaintext keys are never persisted. Can secrets-operator export envelope fingerprints?

devon.k: Yes. secrets-operator stores envelope_fingerprint and kms_key_id on encrypt. I'll export rows for secrets touched during the rollout and include KMS rotation events.

samira: Auditor also wants the CVE patch PR and the risk acceptance doc for that historical vuln we triaged in Feb.

maya.l: Add IR crosswalk mapping control IDs -> runbooks and escalation owners. Auditor asked for a 2-line fallback narrative when KMS is unavailable during deploy.

ops_jordan: Playbook excerpt: if KMS unavailable, deploys are blocked (fail-closed). We check cached envelope metadata for read-only verification paths; emergency key escrow only by SRE lead.

deploy-bot: automated note: session log export started export-20250218-01, ETA ~4m.

auditor_amy: This works. One more: include a short CSV mapping each RBAC change -> PR title -> owner -> justification, helps review speed.

devon.k: Will produce CSV and anonymize email addresses.

maya.l: Plan: devon & samira produce artifacts today, ops_jordan add session samples and playbook excerpt, I will assemble the bundle and run the QA checklist. Target upload to secure share by 2025-02-19 16:00 PT.

samira: Ack. Ping me for the CVE PR link if needed.

ops_jordan: Ack. I'll attach the exported session snippets and playbook excerpt once deploy-bot finishes.

auditor_amy: Thanks all. Ping me here for any clarifications. :thumbsup:
